fields.features_heading: What the Office Gets From Each Registration
fields.features_subheading: A student registration form collects what a school needs before a first day: who the student is, the grade, and who to call.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that change with the grade

A family picks the grade the student is entering, and the form asks only what that grade needs: a preschool history for kindergarten, a transcript request for high school.
fields.feature_2:
Documents photographed on a phone

Parents photograph a birth certificate or a lease with a phone camera and upload it inside the form. Each file stays attached to the student's record for the front office.
fields.feature_3:
A registrar's list sorted by status

Staff see each registration marked new, incomplete, or complete, and can filter by the grade a student is entering. Nobody has to dig through an inbox full of attachments.
fields.feature_4:
Emails to the family at each step

The app emails a family a receipt when they submit, a reminder when a document is missing, and a note when the registration is complete. Every email names the student.
fields.feature_5:
Every registration in a database you own

Registrations save to a database you own, with no response caps. Pull next year's grade 3 list with one filter instead of retyping names from a stack of paper forms.
fields.feature_6:
The whole app's code, in GitHub

On paid plans, export the full code for the form, its database, and the registrar's list to your GitHub repository. Your developer can then host that code or build on it.

fields.tab_content_1:
One upload short of a complete file

Cedar Bluff Academy asks every new family for 3 uploads: a birth certificate, proof of address, and the last report card. Marisela Thibodeaux registers her son Remy for grade 3 and sends 2 of the 3 from her phone. His file shows as incomplete on the registrar's list, and the app emails her a link to the missing report card.
fields.tab_content_2:
Paired with the one tutor free on both afternoons

Quarrystone Tutoring asks each student for a grade, the subjects, and the afternoons they are free. Kwabena Mbatha is in grade 8 and picks Algebra on Tuesdays and Thursdays after 4 pm. The app matches him with Sabeline Corrado, the one Algebra tutor free on both afternoons, and emails her his registration.
fields.tab_content_3:
Which 16 seats go to the waitlist after March 1

Pennock Hill School sends each returning family a re-registration form filled in with last year's answers, and any seat not confirmed by March 1 opens to the waitlist. The app emails a reminder 7 days before the deadline. On March 2, the office sees 198 of 214 students confirmed and 16 seats for the waitlist.
fields.tab_content_4:
Level 3 for anyone who gets 6 or 7 right

Harborlight English School adds 10 placement questions to its registration form, and a score of 6 or 7 correct places an adult student in Level 3. Ottavio Zubiri gets 7 of 10 right and registers for the weekday evening class. His confirmation email says Level 3 and gives Room 204 for his first class.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Student Registration Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to plan a student registration form, decide which documents it collects, and build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List what the office needs first
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Ask which documents you must keep
fields.howto_step_1_des: List the fields the office acts on before a first day: the student's legal name, birth date, the grade they are entering, each guardian's contact details, and the previous school. Leave out anything nobody will use, since every extra question slows a family down.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask your district office which documents your registration should collect, then add one upload for each. Decide whether a registration can count as complete before every file arrives, or whether it waits on the office until the last one is in.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Group the questions that only some students need, such as course records for a transfer into high school or a placement score for adults. Families then answer only their own section, and a kindergarten parent never sees the high school questions.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Write a plain-English description of the form, its sections, the uploads, and who sees each registration. Emergent builds the form, the registrar's list, and the database behind them from that description, and you change any part by prompting again.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Choose what happens when a registration is new, incomplete, or complete, and what each family hears at each stage. A reminder for a missing document can name the file, so the parent knows what to upload without calling the office.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Register a test student from a phone
fields.howto_step_6_des: Submit one test registration for each grade group from a phone, with a photo of a document as one of the uploads. Check that each lands on the registrar's list with the right status and that every email names the right student.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Post the link where families look
fields.howto_step_7_des: Put the link on the admissions page, in the acceptance email, and on a QR code at the open house. Add a question asking how the family heard about the school, so next year's outreach starts from real answers.

faq_plan.q: What is a student registration form?
faq_plan.ref: What is a student registration form?

prov.original: What is a student registration form?

faq_plan.a: A student registration form is the form a family completes to enroll a student with a school or program. It records the student's name and birth date, the grade or level they are joining, their guardians and emergency contacts, and the documents the school keeps on file.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a student registration form?
faq_plan.a: Describe the form in a few sentences: the grades you register, what each grade is asked, the documents to upload, and what a family hears after submitting. Emergent's AI form builder turns that description into a working form with its own database. The free tier covers building and publishing.

faq_plan.q: What fields should a student enrollment form include?
faq_plan.a: Start with the student's legal and preferred names, birth date, and the grade they are entering. Then add who the student lives with, the language spoken at home, 2 emergency contacts besides the guardians, and the previous school's name and city, so the office can request records from it.

faq_plan.q: Can one school registration form cover kindergarten through 12th grade?
faq_plan.a: Yes. One school registration form can ask for the grade first and branch from there, with a section for each band of grades your school runs. The office then keeps one list of registrations instead of several forms. Details that change mid-year, like a new phone number, belong on a student information form.

faq_plan.q: Can a student registration form send records to a student information system?
faq_plan.hint: How to create student registration form in visual studio?
faq_plan.a: Yes, when that system has an API. The app Emergent builds can connect to it and send each completed registration across, so nobody retypes a family's details. Ask the system's vendor for API access and the list of fields it accepts before you build.

faq_plan.q: How should a student registration form handle a parent who is not the one registering?
faq_plan.hint: What is non-registering parent on broward county student registration form?
faq_plan.a: Give that parent their own section: name, relationship to the student, phone, email, and a home address if it differs. Add a question on whether they should get school notices and emergency calls. If a court order limits contact, add an upload for it and ask your district office how staff should handle it.

faq_plan.q: Can a student registration form work for a preschool program?
faq_plan.a: Yes, for a preschool that runs on a school calendar: swap the grade question for an age group and ask for the start date. A program with full-day care and a list of adults allowed to pick up each child is better served by a daycare registration form.

faq_plan.q: How do I collect proof of address on a student registration form?
faq_plan.a: Add an upload field next to the home address and let parents photograph the document with a phone. Print the documents your office accepts right above the field, using the list your district office gives you, so families do not send one you will turn away.

faq_plan.q: How long should a student registration form be?
faq_plan.a: Keep it to what the office needs before a student's first day, and collect the rest later in a shorter follow-up form. Splitting the questions into sections by topic helps a parent on a phone finish in one sitting. Emergent can also build the form as a conversational flow, one question per screen.

faq_plan.q: Can I use a student registration form for a school event or workshop?
faq_plan.a: Not as it stands. A student registration form enrolls a student for a term or a year, with guardians and documents attached. A workshop or a teacher training day needs sessions, a headcount, and a cap on seats instead, which is what a conference registration form is built around.
